name: producing deterministic infographics
x-status: proposed instance; no governance act is claimed. Written in the shape of engineering-services-section/lib/agency/duties/*.json without last-governance-act, which only an admitted authority can set. See system-debt record 2026-10-24-infographic-forms-unadmitted.
office-note: Closest existing office is Red Cup Engineering's senior-engineer (part-of engineering-services-section). The owning section for visual media engineering is the intended seat computer-media-engineering-services-section; moving these forms there is an open decision.
from: A requested infographic (a spec in JSON, or content to be put into one) with its data, its sources and its receiver (a research paper, a video shot, a page).
to: An SVG whose bytes are a pure function of the spec, a layout report, a quality score against the rubric and, where a video frame is wanted, PNGs at the requested video resolution; the receiver has the files and the digests.
cost: Engine source, shipped OFL fonts, open data with a retrieval date, one machine-minute per render; no model call.
otherwise: Refuse with the exact reason: invalid spec, content that does not fit at the minimum scale, data without a source, a glyph the fonts lack. Never ship an infographic whose numbers lack provenance or whose text overflows.
receiver-condition: The receiver (not the producer) opens the SVG and the PNG, checks the digest recorded in the metadata against the spec it supplied, and accepts or returns it. A green test run is not receiving.
